required_events.event: Amy stirred oatmeal on the stove while Will and Amber giggled over their breakfast plates, the kitchen smelling sweet with cinnamon and butter.
A sudden crash rattled the front door; Amy grabbed both kids’ hands, pulled them toward the back stairwell, and shoved them into the safety hatch that led to a hidden closet in the attic.

Amy returned to the kitchen, heart pounding as she slid her hand under the fridge’s latch, pulling out a small metal box from beneath the counter—her hidden arsenal: a pistol and a katana gleaming on its velvet cushion.
The first zombie lunged at her from the pantry doorway; Amy fired the pistol, then sliced the creature with the katana as it staggered back.
She fought each attacker one by one, slashing or shooting until the last fell to the floor in a splatter of blood and brain matter.
More zombies kept coming—another burst through the kitchen window, another from the pantry door—but Amy didn’t pause; she met each new threat with swift strikes and precise shots.
When the final zombie collapsed beside her, shivering but alive, Amy lifted Will’s small hand and pulled Amber toward the hatch.
Together they climbed back into the attic safe room, breathing hard as the last of the undead thudded against the kitchen walls.
